'''Zelcomm Industries''' was a shipping company based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], specializing in cargo transportation between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was run by the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Coruum Sa'dia]]. The company was in truth a front for an illegal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation and Sa'dia directed his illicit business personally from within [[Zelcomm Tower]], the headquarters of Zelcomm Industries, which was situated in [[Sector 1265]]. After the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] incurred the ire of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a group of Pyke-affiliated agents infiltrated Zelcomm Tower while searching for information on Leeachos' activities.
